name: srijika-studio
description: Build, migrate, scaffold, inspect, validate, and run CLI-first Srijika React projects from Codex, with optional Studio visual tools.

interface.shortDescription: Build or migrate Srijika projects with or without Studio
interface.longDescription: Use software-independent MCP tools for immutable-source React migration into a distinct Srijika target and for strict Feature, Slot, Part, and Shared UI/Widget/Headless project inspection, validation, planning, and atomic scaffolding. Migration is reviewed, resumable, traceable, target-only, and fails closed on unsupported behavior or missing evidence. When Srijika Studio is available, connect through its private authenticated bridge to inspect hierarchy, apply visual document operations, validate generated TSX, inspect rendered geometry, and capture clean previews.
capabilities: Migrate an existing React app into a distinct new Srijika target
Resume reviewed migrations with source-to-target traceability
Enforce behavior-free UI and passive Types
Validate deterministic aliases and project imports
Operate CLI-first projects without Desktop Studio
Run Vite with Node or optional Bun
Normalize repeated UI into typed React maps
defaultPrompt: Recreate this design in the running Srijika Studio app and verify it at the source image dimensions.
Analyze repeated siblings, convert the reviewed candidates to typed Repeat nodes, and verify generated React output.
Make the active page responsive without duplicating its component tree, then check mobile, tablet, desktop, and wide layouts.
Inspect the current Srijika page and fix its layout diagnostics.
Add a typed page prop and bind it to the selected component.
Convert an existing React project into a separate Srijika project without modifying the source, then verify every reviewed slice.
